# `cbo_projection_error_summary_stats`

**CBO projection error summary statistics**

Horizon-by-category summary accuracy statistics (mean error, MAE, RMSE, central two-thirds spread) across CBO historical evaluations.

**Coverage.** Derived. Summary error statistics across horizons 1-11 for FY1982-FY2025 revenues (Winter baselines only) and FY1984-FY2025 outlays, deficits, and debt (Spring baselines only), excluding Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, and 2022 student loan forgiveness. *(measured 2026-11-27)*

- **Parquet file:** `cbo_projection_error_summary_stats.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `component` | `VARCHAR` | Budget component (outlay, revenue, deficit, or debt). |
| `category` | `VARCHAR` | Major budget category or Total. |
| `subcategory` | `VARCHAR` | Budget subcategory or Total. |
| `projected_year_number` | `BIGINT` | Forecast horizon from 1 through 11. |
| `projection_year_range` | `VARCHAR` | Inclusive first and last projected fiscal years in the summary sample. |
| `number_of_projections` | `BIGINT` | Count of evaluated baseline projections included in this horizon summary. |
| `error_basis` | `VARCHAR` | Percentage denominator used by the summary metrics (pct_actual for outlays and revenues; pct_gdp for deficits and debt). |
| `average_error_pct` | `DOUBLE` | Mean projection error in percentage points on error_basis. |
| `average_absolute_error_pct` | `DOUBLE` | Mean absolute projection error in percentage points on error_basis. |
| `rmse_pct` | `DOUBLE` | Root mean squared error in percentage points on error_basis. |
| `two_thirds_spread_pct` | `DOUBLE` | Difference between the 5/6 and 1/6 quantiles of errors in percentage points on error_basis. |
| `source_commit` | `VARCHAR` | Pinned 40-character Git commit SHA of US-CBO/eval-projections. |
| `source_url` | `VARCHAR` | Immutable raw GitHub URL for the source summary-stats CSV at source_commit. |
| `source_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | SHA-256 digest of the source summary-stats CSV bytes. |
| `observed_at` | `VARCHAR` | UTC capture timestamp with timezone. |
